pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: scripts/security/__tests__/check-actions.test.mjs:198 Five whole-tree checks in check-actions.test.mjs (lines 198, 288, 391, 479, 524) walk .github/workflows with no floor on how many workflow files they read, so an empty or moved directory reports a clean tree in the voice of a clean tree; the sibling secret-scan test does declare one (files.length > 100).

techniques.evidence: scripts/security/__tests__/check-actions.test.mjs:198 The real-tree walks over .github/workflows select their population by readdir and never assert it is non-zero, so zero selected exits green. dispatch.test.mjs:373 and secret-scan.test.mjs:161 show the floor this file lacks.

scripts/security/__tests__/check-actions.test.mjs:524 The text-reading conformance walk handles line endings properly (the \r?\n split at line 293 is explained in the asserting file), but it misses the rule that the walk declares a floor.

scripts/security/__tests__/secret-scan.test.mjs:66 Every credential row is driven by a seeded literal of its real shape and must fire. Near-misses are pinned not to fire, and a bijection check (line 57) stops a new row from shipping unexercised.
scripts/agent/__tests__/budget.test.mjs:53 Each budget case writes into its own mkdtemp directory, and those directories are reaped on exit. Nothing is inherited from the repo or from a prior case.
scripts/agent/__tests__/injection.test.mjs:33 The file names the decision it cannot cover (model resistance) and narrows its claim to the guard refusing an obedient model's plan.

scripts/agent/__tests__/injection.test.mjs:18 No remote service is recorded or replayed. The model is replaced by a hand-authored worst-case plan, which is the honest-fake case the technique excludes.
